replicaCount.description: Number of desired pods for the chart repository deployment.

image.description: Container image configuration for the main Nginx server.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets used to pull images from private registries.

nameOverride.description: String to partially override the chart name.

fullnameOverride.description: String to fully override the release name.

create.description: Specifies whether a ServiceAccount should be created.

automount.description: Whether to automatically mount the ServiceAccount token.

name.description: The name of the ServiceAccount to use. If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the pod metadata.

podLabels.description: Labels to add to the pod metadata.

fsGroup.description: The GID that owns the pod's volumes.

fsGroupChangePolicy.description: Behavior when changing ownership and permissions of a volume.

runAsNonRoot.description: Indicates that the container must run as a non-root user.

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Allow a process to gain more privileges than its parent process.

service.description: Kubernetes Service configuration for exposing the repository.

port.description: The port that the service will listen on.

containerPort.description: The port that the container listens on (Nginx unprivileged defaults to 8080).

resources.description: CPU and memory resource limits and requests for the main container.

startupProbe.description: Probe to verify that the application has started correctly.

livenessProbe.description: Probe to verify that the application is still running.

readinessProbe.description: Probe to verify that the application is ready to receive traffic.

persistence.description: Persistent volume configuration for chart storage.

storageClass.description: Storage class name for the PVC. Use '-' for default.

accessModes.description: Access modes for the persistent volume.

volumes.description: Additional volumes to define in the deployment spec.

volumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts for the main container.

repoExtractor.description: Configuration for the init container that extracts source code from Flux.

script.description: Shell script logic for artifact extraction.

chartPackager.description: Configuration for the init container that packages Helm charts.

image.description: Container image for the packager (should include Helm CLI).

script.description: Shell script logic for packaging charts and generating index.yaml.

tolerations.description: Pod tolerations for nodes with taints.
